hooks.command: f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty"); case "$f" in *lib/*.dart) d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git -C "$(dirname "$f")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)}"; [ -x "$d/tool/check_layers.sh" ] || exit 0; out=$("$d/tool/check_layers.sh" "$f" 2>&1) || jq -n --arg r "$out" "{decision:\"block\",reason:(\"分层约束校验失败，请修正后继续：\n\"+\$r)}";; esac; exit 0
